en_US.plugin_description: Search a Bitwarden or Vaultwarden vault and copy usernames, passwords and 2FA codes
en_US.settings_connection_tooltip: Base URL of your self-hosted Vaultwarden server
en_US.server_url_tooltip: Defaults to the official cloud at https://vault.bitwarden.com; replace it with your own Vaultwarden URL. No /api or /identity suffix is needed.
en_US.server_url_required: Set the server URL in the plugin settings first
en_US.settings_security_note: The master password is typed into a form and kept only in memory; it is never saved. Logins are limited by the server to about one per minute.
en_US.lock_command: Lock: drop the vault keys from memory
en_US.login_preview:
Enter your account email and master password.

The master password is used once to derive the vault key and is then dropped. It is never written to settings or disk.
en_US.lock_subtitle: Removes vault keys from memory, keeps this session
en_US.already_locked_subtitle: Type pw and enter the master password to unlock
en_US.no_results_subtitle: Try a name, username or domain
en_US.totp_unavailable: Verification code secret cannot be read
en_US.err_2fa_unsupported: This account uses two-step login, which this plugin does not support yet
en_US.err_rate_limited: Too many login attempts, wait about a minute
en_US.err_session_expired: Session expired, run pw and enter the master password again
en_US.err_legacy_key: This account uses the legacy key format without a user key, which is not supported
en_US.err_argon2: This account uses Argon2id, which is not supported yet
en_US.err_prelogin: Could not read the key derivation settings for this account
en_US.err_locked: The vault is locked, run pw to unlock
en_US.err_generic: Request failed, check the plugin log

zh_CN.plugin_description: 搜索 Bitwarden 官方云或自建 Vaultwarden 密码库，复制用户名、密码与两步验证码
zh_CN.settings_connection_tooltip: 私有化部署的 Vaultwarden 服务器地址
zh_CN.server_url_tooltip: 默认是官方云 https://vault.bitwarden.com，自建 Vaultwarden 就换成你自己的地址；不需要带 /api 或 /identity 后缀
zh_CN.server_url_required: 请先在插件设置里填写服务器地址
zh_CN.settings_security_note: 主密码只在表单里输入一次、仅存内存，绝不落盘；服务端登录约每分钟一次限流，请勿反复试错。
zh_CN.lock_command: 锁定：从内存丢弃密码库密钥
zh_CN.login_preview:
输入账号邮箱和主密码。

主密码只用于派生密码库密钥，用完即弃，不写入设置或磁盘。
zh_CN.lock_subtitle: 从内存丢弃密钥，保留本次会话
zh_CN.already_locked_title: 密码库已经处于锁定状态
zh_CN.already_locked_subtitle: 输入 pw 填主密码即可解锁
zh_CN.no_results_subtitle: 试试名称、用户名或域名
zh_CN.err_2fa_unsupported: 该账号启用了两步登录，当前插件版本还不支持
zh_CN.err_rate_limited: 登录过于频繁，请约一分钟后重试
zh_CN.err_session_expired: 会话已过期，重新输入 pw 并填主密码
zh_CN.err_legacy_key: 该账号使用没有 UserKey 的旧版密钥格式，暂不支持
zh_CN.err_argon2: 该账号使用 Argon2id，暂不支持
zh_CN.err_prelogin: 无法读取该账号的密钥派生参数
zh_CN.err_locked: 密码库已锁定，输入 pw 解锁
zh_CN.err_unreachable: 无法连接 Vaultwarden 服务器
zh_CN.err_generic: 请求失败，请查看插件日志
